description: The plot illustrates the relationship between AUC percentage and N, comparing the performance of five different models or configurations. The x-axis is labeled 'N', has a linear scale, and ranges from 0 to 20 with tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled 'AUC (%)', also has a linear scale, and ranges from 75 to 100 with tick labels at intervals of 5. Five lines are plotted: a blue line with circle markers, starting at around 95% AUC at N=1 and ending at around 93% AUC at N=20, with a peak of approximately 98% at N=5; an orange line with diamond markers, starting at around 87% AUC at N=1 and ending at around 93% AUC at N=20, with a peak of around 95% at N=10; a green line with star markers, starting at around 84% AUC at N=1 and ending at around 92% AUC at N=20, showing a steady increase; a red line with square markers, starting at around 86% AUC at N=1, peaking at around 97% AUC at N=10, and ending at around 90% AUC at N=20; and a purple line with triangle markers, starting at around 79% AUC at N=1, peaking sharply at around 95% AUC at N=10, and ending at around 81% AUC at N=20.
